newsitem.title: USA: CYBEX, Forza re-enter joint venture.
newsitem.headline: CYBEX, Forza re-enter joint venture.

text.p: CYBEX International Inc and the Forza Group Ltd said Friday that they have renegotiated the terms of the joint venture and distribution agreement that began in the fourth quarter of 1996 prior to the previously announced merger of CYBEX and Trotter Inc.

Under the terms of the new agreement, Forza Fitness Equipment Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Forza Group Ltd, will become the exclusive distributor of all CYBEX products for the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Russia and of all the countries formally known as the Soviet Union.

CYBEX, headquartered in Medway, Massachussetts, manufactures and sells premium quality cardiovascular and strength training equipment to the commercial and home markets. CYBEX manufactures its cardiovascular products under the Trotter brand name and its strength training equipment under the CYBEX brand name.
Forza Fitness Equipment, headquartered in London, England, distributes fitness equipment.
